notes: Linux/Android jobs and Android-specific recipes are unchanged. Shared changes are dev-only Tokio test-util, bridge comments, and the added Mac ARM Flutter variable.

macOS ARM64 now requires Flutter 3.44.9, the separately generated Flutter 3.44.8 bridge, reviewed GNU-sed source transforms and CocoaPods instead of implicit SwiftPM. x86_64 and older sources retain their prior SDK/recipe.

Mac ARM approval is coupled to macos-arm64-policy.json and macos_arm64 source/bridge/worker/package receipts. A signature alone cannot bypass those checks. Native package/runtime validation is not claimed by this static review.
